training_rows.representation: coda output at p_{c-1} with the whole prefix at depth k (table run), theta_S
training_rows.previous_depths: k = 16 for line 1, all five candidates otherwise
training_rows.cost_per_token: mean table NLL + lambda r(d) + kappa_s s(d|k) + kappa_e e(d|k), history uniform at k
training_rows.weights: each document sums to 1; a line gets its share of scored tokens; previous-depth variants split the line weight equally

readout.form: p = softmax(W x + beta), x = [(z - m) / sigma ; position features (10)]
readout.standardisation: per-dimension mean and sd of z over training rows
readout.objective: weighted soft-label cross entropy on p + gamma * ||W||_F^2
readout.gamma_selection: 5-fold grouped CV (document index mod 5) on weighted held-out cross entropy, at lambda 1.5; same gamma for all lambda
readout.lambda_rule: greedy b = 0 sequential table execution on readout_train documents; min |log(relative cost / 0.5)|; ties to the smaller lambda

deployment.search: predicted cost from calibration table scores, online execution of the parameters nearest the budget, outward moves until online costs bracket the budget
deployment.alignment: document-level mixture of the bracketing pair, weight fixed on calibration

comparator_R.family: position ridge on table NLL (v3.1 section 6.1)

technical.sharpness: share(max p >= 0.999) <= share(max s >= 0.999) + 0.05 on calibration table rows
technical.calibration_resolution: bracketing predicted cost levels differ by <= 0.02

effect.statistic: g_head = L(theta_S, pi_R) - L(theta_S, pi_head), per-document paired

stage2.status: structure fixed; numerical details to be written here before stage 2 starts

E-C.control: v3.1 E control loss with p in place of mu

shared: readout (stage-1 recipe on frozen-model tables, frozen)

quantities: actual G change after one step from the same optimiser state

statistics: g_E-C over its own position schedule
